Notes: The 1-month version works for 6 or 12 month holding periods, but not 1 month.
Detailed Definition: In each month, count the number of days with no trades. Define zerotrade as the number of days without trades plus (the sum of monthly turnover (vol/shrout) divided by 48*10$^5$), multiplied by 21/number of trading days per month. Take 1-month average.
